item.title: DISTRICT 2 GIRLS BASKETBALL: Hazleton Area repeats as Class 6A champs
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — These Hazleton Area singers can play a little basketball. Their friends are pretty good at the game, too. One night after wowing a packed house at their home gym with their rendition of the national anthem, Kaitlyn Bindas, Sophia Benyo and Addy Fritz returned to their regular gigs on Friday night: helping the Lady Cougars maintain its stranglehold on the District 2 Class 6A girls’ championship. item.title: NE REGIONAL WRESTLING: District 2 advances eight to Class 2A semifinals
item.description: WILLIAMSPORT – If you get through the PIAA Class 2A Northeast Regional at Williamsport High School, it’s a sign of potential success at the state championship at the Giant Center in Hershey. item.title: DISTRICT 2 BOYS BASKETBALL: Abington Heights uses size to claim fourth straight 5A title
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — The immediate energy Crestwood brought to start the District 2 Class 5A boys basketball championship game was something Mark Atherton felt needed to happen. Eventually, Abington Heights’ size and experience proved to be the difference. Abington Heights won its fourth consecutive Class 5A district championship with a 57-37 win over Crestwood on Friday night at Mohegan Arena. item.title: D2 SWIMMING: Scranton Prep shines, Tunkhannock, Dallas lead Class 2A
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — Scranton Prep’s stars shined and Tunkhannock’s boys showed off its depth on day one of the District 2 Class 2A Swimming Championships at the Wyoming Valley Catholic Youth Center on Friday. item.title: NE REGIONAL WRESTLING: Caufield, Drake, Schechterly into 3A semifinals
item.description: BETHLEHEM — When Gabe Caufield won his quarterfinal match, boos rained down from the stands inside Liberty High School’s gym. As Caufield walked off the mat, Wallenpaupack coach Steve Krushnowski told his senior wrestler, “When they’re booing you, you’re doing something right.” Caufield rallied from a five-point, third-period deficit to secure a 10-9 victory over Nazareth’s Elijah Simak in the 172-pound quarterfinals of the Class 3A Northeast Regional. item.title: VFW Wozniak-Pavloski Post 7963 Ladies Auxiliary hosts food sale
item.description: The Wozniak-Pavloski VFW Post 7963 Ladies Auxiliary, Eynon, is holding an inaugural Lenten foods fundraiser March 20 and April 3. They are selling quarts of homemade potato soup, broccoli cheddar soup, cabbage and noodles (halushki), as well as tuna hoagies, cash only. Preorders for the March 20 sale must be in by March 16, and preorders for the April 3 sale must be in by March 30. Pickup is 3-6 p.m. at the post’s side door. Open to the public with free parking. item.title: Team Allied Services has record-breaking year at TCS New York City Marathon
item.description: After months of training, teamwork and community support, Allied Services celebrated a record-breaking year for Team Allied Services, raising $645,974 to benefit programs that empower individuals at every stage of life — from children taking their first steps to seniors and veterans regaining strength, independence and dignity. The grand finale, hosted live on WNEP-TV from Toyota MotorWorld in Wilkes-Barre, brought together runners, sponsors and supporters to celebrate the milestone achievement.
